correctness.rationale: Bids below reserve except zero are dominated; no positive atom below the cap because an infinitesimal overbid beats ties. Continuous support indifference yields F(b)=(b/V)^{1/(N-1)} with payoff zero. Uniform cap tie probability equals S_N(q)/N, fixing q uniquely for 1<V<N and continuous endpoint Vq^{N-1}. If endpoint≤r the distribution is only atoms at zero and cap; otherwise it has the positive continuous interval [r,endpoint]. For r<V≤1 support ends at V, and V≥N gives all bids at cap. Strictly monotone S_N(q)/q^{N-1} gives unique threshold and checks boundaries including V=Vc; Riemann sums with q_c=exp(-a_N/N) give limit r+a_r. Independent numerics for 24 (N,r) pairs, including N=2 Vc=2-r, corroborate but are not a proof.
